notes: Research 2026-11-13. No clinic page opened explicitly says 24 h / 24/7, so no emergency_24h entries. No duty rota and no animal poison line found. All entries come from the official TTVA member directory (each practice page opened); no clinic own websites were found or opened. Not reachable: noonsite.com (client error), TTVA home page and TTVA doctors-list page 2 (fetch refused), vetshunter.com (no data). Not opened, remaining TTVA members: Aminalz, Bark N' Shake (Sangre Grande), Brown's Pet Care, Companion Care, Creature Care (St. Joseph), Debe Animal Clinic, Felicity (Chaguanas), Exotic Pets Plus (Couva), Freeport, Gasparillo, Infinity Paws, Island Haven (mobile, Diego Martin), Kairi (Penal), Paws Fins and Feathers / Paws n Claws (Princes Town), Pet Avenue (Fyzabad), Pet Point (Enterprise), Petoline, PetWell TT (mobile), Sarah's, Solomon's, Sunny Paws, Sunnyview (Diego Martin), Naive Terrain, Dr. Philbert (Maraval), Siparia and Point Fortin clinics.
